COBOL (COmmon Business-Oriented Language) is one of the oldest high-level programming languages still in use today, primarily for business applications like banking, finance, insurance, and government services. It has a distinctive syntax and readability that makes it easy to write maintainable code. Some of its key features include a clear English-like syntax, self-documenting code, and a large pool of experienced programmers due to its long history. However, it may not be the best choice for modern web development or mobile applications.
